note: Route A with Pressure for Help (Keel S25; Sky Q4): Pressure leans on her affair, learned by Listen ($0, +3 T, no step worse whatever her temperament: Motive, motive-lovers.md); the r016 cast's Inez is Fearful, so Pressure is also her own approach and one order turns her; the rest is route A. The cell runs where a player in a hurry would (to the café, the cabinet and the door): a run is noticed (Alert 1 at most), which the quiet route can afford.

steps.why: to the café terrace, where Inez can be watched
to wait beside the Office approach, out of the guard's cone

steps.label: reroute
steps.why: the idle Tech sends the patrol off its sweep, so the entry needn't wait for a gap

steps.label: enter
steps.why: the first moment the door is unwatched: guard away, camera looped, patrol off its sweep
back to the getaway car to cover the extraction
the loop is no longer needed once the Enforcer is inside

steps.label: hold
steps.why: out of the service door with Vale, to a point 19.5 m south-east of the car, off the rivals' posts by the planters: the ambush springs at 20 m, and the Enforcer holds there while the cell fights
the ambush: the armed cell fires at will

steps.label: out
steps.why: the last rival down: to the car

steps.label: in
steps.why: Vale into the car first (Board, 4 s carrying; brief 018 §2)
fight it out: the crew is broken and the car free, so the car leaves at once; the three walk out on a calm street (brief 018 §3), which costs nothing, so they do not spend time boarding
